# translation result

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:translationResult`](gmeow-translationResult.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/translationResult>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/archaeological-evidence`](../../slices/archaeological-evidence.md)

The lexical form(s) produced by a translation. Non-functional: competing translations of the same inscription coexist without privilege ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).
